audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Breath of Life as matchup-defining but never states its cooldown (lint rule: field must contain a digit).
audit.why: Breath of Life is 160/145/130s. That's a very long cooldown — once Milio burns it to cleanse a CC chain, Poppy's all-in window stays open for the rest of the game's early/mid phase, which is the actual strategic point being made.
audit.corrected: Add the real cooldown figure to breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: Both layers already correctly identify Breath of Life (R) as a team-wide CC-cleanse that undoes Poppy's hardCC chain (E stun, W ground, R knockup) — the single most important interaction in this matchup — and content's spikes/wants already key the level-6 all-in to knocking Milio off his ADC before he can use it.

Content already states Milio out-pokes early (Q knockback + passive burn) and Poppy's window opens at 6 with R — matches the 52.53% winrate (close, Poppy-favored) and the packet's chart (Milio favored levels 1-5 and 2+ items, Poppy favored at 6).

edits.before: - Milio Breath of Life: matchup-defining — The team-wide cleanse-heal undoes your CC chain — force it early, engage after. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Steadfast Presence answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Milio Breath of Life: matchup-defining — 160/145/130s cooldown; the team-wide cleanse-heal undoes your CC chain, so bait it out early and engage after it's gone. - Your W Steadfast Presence answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
